name: cysteine rich hydrophobic domain 2

function.text: CHIC2 encodes cysteine-rich hydrophobic domain-containing protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and protein complex scaffold activity.

function.text: CHIC2 encodes a protein containing a cysteine-rich hydrophobic CHIC motif. The protein has been localized to vesicular structures and the plasma membrane. These observations establish features of its cellular distribution, while its detailed molecular activity remains less well defined than that of a characterized receptor or enzyme.
